prompts.TE:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: original typography-led T-shirt print artwork with a transparent background.
Input image 1 (TE-sofa-v3-detail) is the edit target and exact composition/type/scale reference. Input image 2 (TE-sofa-first-detail) supplies ONLY the preferred sofa design/style.
Replace only the sofa in image 1 with the ornate three-seat antique sofa from image 2, fitting it into approximately the same small supporting footprint as the sofa in image 1. Crucially retain image 2's shaped exposed wooden frame, central shell/fan crest, gently arched three-section back, carved curved lower apron, scrolled arms and turned legs. These distinctive ornamental contours make the sofa read visibly old/antique. Do not simplify it back to the plain rectangular/transitional back or straight lower rail in image 1. Use a few clear contour details that survive at small shirt scale, not dense microscopic ornament.
Keep the sofa broad enough to read three seats; retain the small blank dealer tag hanging from the right arm. Sofa remains subordinate to the words, centered beneath them, separated by clean space. Warm ivory flat linework matching the type. NO glow, halo, blur, shadow, lighting effects, ground line, extra objects, or car.
Preserve all typography, line breaks, wording, relative type sizes, centering, spacing above the sofa and palette of image 1. Exact text: "DO YOU" / "DELIVER?" / "I asked, after paying."
Return the entire print composition, uncropped, with a little transparent outer padding. The gray ground is a viewing aid only: remove it to actual transparency, leaving warm ivory ink shapes and clean transparent negative spaces. No shirt, no background panel, no new words.
prompts.NA:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset: original framed valuation-card T-shirt print artwork, transparent outside the frame.
The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET. Make only these two text changes:
1. Change the top headline from "PRICE: $8" to exactly "PRICE: $2". Preserve the same navy vintage lettering, large price numeral, composition, scale and alignment.
2. Replace the handwritten "$8" on the small attached paper tag with exactly "SALE" in clear dark navy uppercase letters, readable on the same tag. No currency or numeral on that tag. Keep the same physical tag size, tilt, punched eyelet, string loop and attachment to the bowl.
Preserve the worn old striped ceramic bowl, its navy/rust/cream palette, empty interior, illustration style, border shape, all spacing, and every other word. Exact full wording after editing: "PRICE: $2" at top; "SALE" on tag; "SENTIMENTAL VALUE:" then "PLEASE DON'T" then "TELL THE SELLER." below bowl.
Do not add food, dirt clumps, extra aging, extra tags, crossed-out prices, discount stickers, new labels, shadows or ornaments. Preserve the tag's quiet integration; no vivid red sale sticker.
Return the complete uncropped artwork at high detail with actual transparency OUTSIDE the outer frame and the existing cream paper/ceramic areas preserved inside. The pale exterior ground in the reference is just a viewing ground, not a rectangular print background. Do not change the composition or garment palette.
